name: lensiq
description: Self-hosted dashboards for Notion: tables, boards and charts over your Notion databases.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
